training_budget_definition: 448 observation queries/action chunks per optimizer step, not 448 episodes or 448 groups; 4 ranks * 16 chronological queries * 7 accumulated forwards
sampler: equal task probability; chronological full episode groups; incomplete query tails excluded and reported, invalid action horizons remain masked
model_initialization: fresh pinned official Qwen visual/text weights; freshly initialized original DiT-S and MemoryVLA Bank/SE layers; not the OFT smoke checkpoint

official_budget_evidence.paper_claim: Mem-0 execution module: single-task, 8 A800 GPUs, global batch 448, 30K iterations, about 18 hours per task
official_budget_evidence.mixed_claim: M1 five-task release config: batch_size 56 per device, 50000 steps; released run world size is not confirmed
official_budget_evidence.distinction: The user approved 448/30000 for our Qwen3.5+MemoryVLA diffusion native10 mixed experiment; not an official reproduction recipe

evaluation_seed_rule: For each task, deterministically attempt seeds 100000..102499 and count the first 50 native expert/setup-valid policy episodes. Skips occur before policy inference and are logged. Completed policy outcomes are never retried.
evaluation_rng: Diffusion inference seeded per task/episode as SHA256(training_seed:task_name:native_seed), independent of worker scheduling
evaluation_gate: Run only after training exits successfully, progress reports completed_steps=30000 and completed status, and the final full-model checkpoint passes source/config checks
safety: Before each new allocation require GPU utilization <50%, available selected ports, and no duplicate owned job. Do not modify shared environments, task rules or other processes. A failed run/evaluation is reported without automatic policy-outcome retries.
